summary: Frontend-only retest of the shared scroll lock (lib/scrollLock.js, no position:fixed; html+body overflow hidden + wheel/touch preventDefault + scroll guard). Doctor (medico@mantmed.it) and portal (genitore.demo@example.com). Tested at 1920x800 with page.mouse.wheel bursts (8-30 events of 40-120px, like a trackpad) and at 390x844 with real CDP touch swipes. We checked window.scrollY, the inner scrollTop, and the html/body styles after closing. WORKS (scrollY never changed while an overlay was open, inner content scrolls, closing restores the exact y, the page scrolls again afterwards): Ctrl+K global search (list scrolls 0->258, scrollY stays 300 when wheeling over the dialog and outside it, Esc restores 300); scroll guard (window.scrollTo(0,50) while locked is reset to 300); Compliance/GDPR panel (inner 0->1000); Passport overlay (inner to max 95, page still); Consultation overlay opened from the passport; Consent dialog on top of the consultation overlay (dialog scrolls 0->28, the overlay and the page stay still); Home visit-detail Sheet (oggi-detail); profile DropdownMenu (no background scroll); the top-bar hover menu (navmenu Pazienti: aria-expanded=true, body not locked, the page wheel-scrolls 0->200); portal Richiedi appuntamento dialog (inner 0->383, y=100 kept); Condividi con un medico dialog (share-informativa scrolls, y=600 kept); portal bell popover. Mobile portal: the Altro drawer locks (y=400 kept during swipes); the request dialog swipes to its bottom (463) and back, the page stays at 1115, and the page swipes normally afterwards. REGRESSION from iteration_64 is FIXED: 'Rivedi tour' from the profile menu with the page scrolled now scrolls to 0. The card is on screen at every step (doctor 9/9 steps, Next works, finish closes it). The portal tour also starts with its card on screen. NEW HIGH BUG: while ANY overlay is open, every position:sticky element stops sticking. That includes the sticky TopBar header (search + profile chip) and the oggi-side column. With the page scrolled, the sticky header jumps off-screen (top 13 -> -223) and the right column jumps 113px the moment a dialog/sheet/menu opens, then jumps back on close. To the user this looks like the background moving, which most likely explains 'col pad continua a non funzionare'. Side effect: the profile dropdown is anchored to the now-unstuck trigger and opens off-screen (doctor menu top -178px: Area personale / Cambia password / Sicurezza cannot be seen; portal menu top -280px, only 'Esci' visible). Bodychart editor was NOT retested this round.

ui_bugs.issue: Sticky elements stop sticking while locked. If html AND body both have overflow:hidden, body becomes its own scroll container (its overflow is no longer passed to the viewport). Its scrollTop is 0, so every position:sticky child goes back to its normal place. Measured at scrollY=300: global-search-trigger top 13 -> -223, oggi-side 96 -> -17, and the 'Note da firmare' card 206 -> 93 as soon as Ctrl+K / the Sheet opens. All restored on close. Proven by setting each style alone: html only => no jump; body only => no jump; html+body => jump. Radix adds 'body[data-scroll-locked]{overflow:hidden !important}' itself, so removing body overflow in lockScroll alone is NOT enough. Injecting 'html body{overflow:visible !important}' fixed both the sticky jump and the menu position, and the page still did not scroll on wheel (y stays 300/400).

ui_bugs.component: ProfileMenu DropdownMenu (doctor doctor-chip, portal 'Giulia Ricci' trigger)
ui_bugs.issue: Comes from the bug above. With the page scrolled (y=300/400), clicking the profile chip opens the menu off-screen: doctor menu rect [-178,106], so only 'Rivedi tour'/'Esci' are visible. Portal menu [-280,24], so only part of 'Esci' is visible. Area personale / Cambia password / Sicurezza e 2FA / Rivedi tour cannot be reached with the mouse. With the body overflow override in place: portal menu [56,360], correct.

issues: consent-relation-select is a native <select>, and appointment date/time use the browser's native date/time pickers instead of shadcn Select/Calendar (not in scope, noted only)

action_items: Fix the sticky jump while locked. In lockScroll set overflow:hidden (and overscrollBehavior) on documentElement ONLY, not on body. Also add global CSS with higher specificity to cancel react-remove-scroll-bar's body rule, e.g. in index.css: 'html body[data-scroll-locked]{overflow:visible !important;margin-right:0 !important}'. Alternative: body overflow:clip, which does not create a scroll container. Then recheck that header.sticky and [data-testid=oggi-side] keep their getBoundingClientRect().top when Ctrl+K / Sheet / profile menu open at scrollY=300.

After the fix, confirm that the profile menu opens under the chip when the page is scrolled (doctor-chip and the portal profile trigger), and that the wheel still does not move the page (html overflow:hidden + wheel handler + scroll guard are enough).
critical_code_review_comments: scrollLock.js comment says 'niente position:fixed: le barre sticky ... restano al loro posto', but body overflow:hidden together with html overflow:hidden breaks sticky positioning. Radix's react-remove-scroll does the same on body for Dialog/Sheet/Select.

onWheel returns early when |deltaX|>|deltaY|. Diagonal trackpad swipes are then not prevented. This is harmless today only because html overflow:hidden blocks viewport scroll. Keep html overflow:hidden after the fix.
GuidedTour does not lock the scroll itself (body overflow '' during the tour). This is intended, because it calls window.scrollTo between steps.

rca of the issue: Repro: /app, scroll to 300, press Ctrl+K: the sticky top bar disappears and the content jumps up 113px. Or click the profile chip: the menu renders above the viewport. Cause: CSS overflow propagation. When the root (html) has overflow != visible, body's overflow is no longer propagated to the viewport. body overflow:hidden then makes body a scroll container with scrollTop 0, so position:sticky descendants use body as their scrollport and un-stick. Fix: lock only html, and force body overflow to visible/clip while locked (including over Radix's body[data-scroll-locked] !important rule). Verified live by injecting the CSS override: sticky positions unchanged, menu at [56,360], wheel still blocked.
